glossary.definition: The agent gateway enforces a business boundary (one configurable US state by default, or "any", or everywhere except an admin-blocked city) on a third-party MCP tool — entirely at the edge. A denied call never reaches the backend; the backend stays unmodified and policy-blind.

The allowed state is admin-editable and read on every request: switching it flips the outcome of the very next call, with no gateway restart. A policy that needs a redeploy is not externalized governance.

City names are matched exactly, split on the first comma — no substring containment: "Plano, IL" and "Miami, OH" are real, different cities and stay allowed. Coordinates are checked as well as names, because the agent geocodes first.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol: tools/call
sources.use: The JSON-RPC tool-call shape the gateway scopes.

cards.label: Scenario 1: PERMIT: Austin under the Texas policy
cards.description: Austin is in Texas — the gateway forwards the call and the third-party server answers normally. The server never learns a policy exists.

cards.label: Scenario 2: DENY: Miami under the Texas policy
cards.description: Miami is outside Texas — the gateway refuses BEFORE the third-party server ever sees the request. The backend never runs.

cards.label: Scenario 3: RECONFIGURE: the same Miami call after switching to Any
cards.description: The exact same call flips from denied to permitted because the policy changed — live, no restart. The scope is admin-owned, not app logic.

cards.label: Scenario 4: DENY: resolved coordinates outside Texas
cards.description: The agent geocoded first and called with latitude/longitude (Miami): the bounding-box branch catches it even without a city name.

cards.label: Scenario 5: ALLOWED: "Miami, OH" is a different city
cards.description: A differently qualified name does not match the blocked label: Miami, OH is a real, different city. Exact matching, no substring containment.

cards.label: Scenario 6: DENY: the capability flag is off
cards.description: With the showcase flag off, every weather call is refused regardless of location — a capability kill switch above the scope check.

cards.label: Reconfigure the policy live
cards.description: Switch the allowed state, add a blocked city, or turn the capability off; the SAME call flips on the next run.

cards.label: Doctor and health
cards.description: Preflight checks and the demo-health/1 endpoint.
